channel.title: Carolina Public Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Carolina Public Press (carolinapublicpress.org)

item.title: A quicker, cheaper college degree. UNC System could offer option with fewer credits.
item.description: Many state and private colleges are moving toward 90-credit undergrad degree option. UNC System weighing pros and cons.

item.title: Illegal solitary confinement found in review of NC juvenile detention
item.description: One juvenile facility closed over solitary confinement findings. Despite denials from locals across NC, state warns them to change practices.

item.title: Making sense of two SAVEs and very few noncitizens voting in NC
item.description: Divided State Board of Elections votes to use SAVE to target small number of noncitizens voting. Some worry citizen voters will be affected.

item.title: Realigning the UNC System to meet NC workforce needs
item.description: Review shows one degree program after another in which UNC System isn't producing as many graduates as growing NC economy requires.

item.title: First freight train rolls into Asheville from Old Fort since Helene
item.description: Damage to remote parts of the Norfolk Southern rail line kept freight traffic stalled for months. Now passenger service could make comeback.

item.title: Rocky Mount seeks to recover after scathing NC audit finds serious financial mistakes
item.description: State auditor report finds improper hiring of underqualified personnel with insufficient oversight led to money woes plaguing Rocky Mount.

item.title: Voter registration groups cry foul over NC decision to stop providing them with printed forms
item.description: No more printing NC voter registration forms will cut costs, NC election board says. Advocacy groups question timing, motive, legality.

item.title: NC Senate leader trailing primary challenger after recount seeks another recount
item.description: Sen. Berger complains about differing methods in Guilford and Rockingham counties during first recount as he calls for another recount.

item.title: 'Wandering officers' widespread across NC police agencies
item.description: Limited data makes wandering officers hard to count in NC, but CPP identified nearly 700 current cops whose previous agencies fired them.

item.title: How NC fails to track and prevent 'wandering officers'
item.description: Decertifying wandering officers isn't automatic. Some law enforcement agencies reluctant to share records. Some aren't cautious in hiring.

item.title: Berger concedes defeat after two recounts
item.description: Rockingham County Sheriff Sam Page has won his primary challenge against NC Senate leader Phil Berger, who conceded Tuesday.

item.title: Changes to NC policies and laws could reduce hiring of 'wandering officers'
item.description: A few changes from NC policymakers and legislators could reduce hiring of law enforcement officers with serious misconduct records.
